text:
toni: noticed p99 spikes in dedicated-usw2 around 11:02. small chat prompts jump 2x, coincides with PCIe retry counters on node set r4. any recent migrations?
hal: saw the telemetry. which tenant?
toni: tenant=acct-314 shows a flood of small streams; pcierr log snippet: 
```
2026-04-12T11:02:14Z node-agent[r4n7]: pcie_retries=412 delta=+380
2026-04-12T11:02:15Z net-proxy[proxy-2]: egress_bytes tenant=acct-314 delta=60MB/s
2026-04-12T11:02:16Z scheduler: slab-split tenant=acct-314 reason=hotspot
```
toni: looks like the tenant's quantized model inference is triggering high PCIe traffic and causing local slab fragmentation. that heats up the host and impacts co-tenants.
devon: acct-314 was moved during the fractional carveover at 10:50. their prefill job may be mis-sized. can we check migration events?
oncall-sre: i'm oncall. short mitigations: 1) leash acct-314 egress to 30MB/s, 2) move their slice to a quieter rack if available, 3) enable temporary prefetch=false for their tenant. ops commands: 
```bash
rctl tenant update acct-314 --prefetch=false --note="temp-no-prefill-pcierr"
rctl config set prod pool-proxy egress_leash_per_tenant=true
ctl config set prod pool-proxy egress_leash_bytes_per_sec=31457280
```
oncall-sre: i'll apply leash and prefetch toggle first. moving slices needs approval.
hal: before migration, can we confirm PCIe errors correlate with their traffic and not a bad host? quick query: 
```sql
SELECT node, sum(pcie_retries) FROM infra.pcie_stats WHERE time > now() - 20m GROUP BY node ORDER BY sum DESC LIMIT 5;
```
devon: query shows r4n7 top, but r4n8 also spiked slightly. r4n7 has acct-314 pinned.
toni: if host-level, we might need to quarantine. but given the migration at 10:50, prioritizing tenant isolation is safer short-term.
oncall-sre: applied egress leash and prefills disabled. infra-bot: config change recorded user=oncall-sre action=set pool-proxy.egress_leash_per_tenant=true at=2026-04-12T11:06:02Z
infra-bot: tenant acct-314 prefills=false applied at=2026-04-12T11:06:05Z
hal: watching p99 and pcie counters. initial numbers: p99 down from 420ms to ~180ms in 70s. pcie_retries stabilized but still elevated.
devon: follow-ups: 1) add a promotion-time check that refuses fractional moves if recent PCIe retry delta > X, 2) add per-tenant quick-health probe that runs a 2s warmup and measures host pcie headroom before allowing cross-rack prefill, 3) add alert for node pcie_retries > 300 over 5m. i'll file PRs.
billing-bot: provisional egress overage flagged for acct-314; ops will reconcile.
toni: thanks. if pcie_retries continue to climb after leash, we'll open a hardware ticket and consider draining r4n7. closing for now unless it flares back.
